title: Tests and re-measurement
intro: The fixes in sections A–C remove work that does not show on screen, so they can regress silently. These tests pin the behaviour: rows are not recreated on list updates, rows release their listeners, and the header state is emitted once per change. Re-measurement on the same phone closes the loop.
